rows.title: During an amendment, pages end with Save and return, Save and continue and Save and return to overview, and Continue on the amend review is held while anything is incomplete, in animals and plants
rows.detail: While amending, Design Release 2.1 lets the trader save a page and go straight back to the amend review, carry on to the next page, or return to the overview, and it quietly holds Continue on the amend review until every answer is complete and valid. Today a Change link opens a question in change mode and saving always returns to the notification view, and an amendment reaches the declaration only once every task row is fulfilled. After this change each overview-linked page ends with 'Save and return' (to the amend review), 'Save and continue' and a link-styled 'Save and return to overview' while amending; the party pickers, the CPH number page and the permanent address page show the first two only (c-210); question pages keep their usual Back links; and Continue on an incomplete or invalid amend review leaves the trader there with no error summary (c-201). The buttons post the real service's own fields: exit=hub and ?change=1 stay, with no new action field (c-267). The 9 October afternoon ruling makes the same change in the high-risk plants frontend in the same increment: its save actions get the same three amend controls, its pickers the same two buttons, and its amend review holds Continue without an error summary.
acceptanceCriteria: While a notification is being amended, each page the overview links to ends with a primary 'Save and return' button, a secondary 'Save and continue' button and a link-styled 'Save and return to overview' button, with no cancel link (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-071, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-072; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-114, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-116)

'Save and return' saves the page and goes to the amend review, which shows the changed answer; 'Save and continue' saves and goes to the next page; 'Save and return to overview' saves and goes to the overview hub (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-114, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-116, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-119; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-071, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-072)

A question page opened from a Change link on the amend review ends with the same three controls, and 'Save and return' brings the trader back to the amend review showing the changed answer (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-119; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-072)

The three amend controls submit the page's existing form fields: 'Save and return to overview' still sends exit=hub and a page opened from a Change link still carries ?change=1; no new action field is sent (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-089; c-267)

While amending, the party pickers, the CPH number page and the permanent address page end with 'Save and return' (primary, to the amend review) and 'Save and continue' (secondary) only, without 'Save and return to overview'; outside an amendment they keep their single primary button (c-210; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-055)

During an amendment, question pages keep the journey's usual Back links (the origin of the import back to the notification type page, arrival details back to the overview hub), never a Back link to the amend review (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-073)

Continue on the amend review while an answer is incomplete or invalid (for example an arrival date changed to more than 6 months ahead) leaves the trader on the amend review with no error summary and no error message, and the notification stays being amended (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-074; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-117, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-118; c-201)

In the high-risk plants frontend, while a plants notification is being amended, each overview-linked plants page ends with the same 'Save and return', 'Save and continue' and link-styled 'Save and return to overview' controls going to the same places, and the plants party pickers (consignor, place of destination and contact) end with 'Save and return' and 'Save and continue' only (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-017)

In the high-risk plants frontend, Continue on an incomplete plants amend review leaves the trader on that review with no error summary and no error message (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-017; c-201)
rows.gate: Look at the amend endings on one overview-linked page and on the CPH number page, in animals and in plants, and at the held Continue: every page area's own rows keep these endings while amending.
rows.notes: Unchanged by this re-distil: requirements and rulings behind it stand as they were. Pass 2 combines the page endings (req-1403), the Back links (req-1404) and the held Continue (req-1406), with plants' half (req-2068) in the same increment (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-017): all are how an amendment moves between its pages, built and reviewed through the same amend walk. Plants keeps its own pages and step order. The overview-and-review row inc-110 must not carry a criterion that an incomplete amendment's Continue shows an error summary (c-201). The tests repo's change-from-cya and amend-resubmit specs move from the ?change=1 return to these controls. Keep its journey-foundation theme: it changes the shared save actions every page area renders.

rows.title: Amend goes through a confirmation page, then opens the amend review, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 asks a trader to confirm before amending a submitted notification, then takes them straight to the notification's review page so they can see and change their answers. Today the card's Amend is a form button that starts the amendment straight away and lands on the overview hub, one step away from the review; plants' card Amend does the same. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps the confirmation as a separate page at the notification's own amend route, carrying the pop-up's wording as page content, with no pop-up (c-190; the pop-up waits on design in its own row). Every way into an amendment goes through it: 'Amend this notification' on the view page and the card's Amend become links to it (c-310), and its 'Yes, continue' is a form post with the CSRF crumb (c-189). Confirming lands on the amend review. An amend that cannot happen returns the trader to the set's own notification list (c-198). Plants gets the same page, landing on plants' own review page, and its refused amend goes to plants' own list. The k6 amendment journey moves with the landing (c-225).
acceptanceCriteria: 'Amend this notification' on a Submitted notification's view page, and Amend on its card in the set's notification list, open a page titled 'Amend notification' with the level-1 heading 'Amend notification' and the question 'Are you sure you want to change this notification?', and the notification stays Submitted until the trader confirms (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-046, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-181; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-084; c-190; c-310)

'Yes, continue' on the amend confirmation page is a button that submits the page's form and starts the amendment; the trader lands on that notification's review page showing it is being amended, not on its overview hub (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-048, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-081; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-110, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-124; c-189; c-191)

'No, go back' on the amend confirmation page is a link-styled control that returns to the notification's view page with the notification still Submitted, and the page's Back link goes to the view page too (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-049; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-084)
The amend confirmation page works with JavaScript turned off, and no pop-up opens over the view page or the list when Amend is chosen (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-088; c-190)

Opening or posting Amend for a notification that is not Submitted (such as one already being amended from another tab) or whose reference is unknown changes nothing and returns the trader, with no message, to the set's own notification list (the live-animals set root) (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-129; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-092, repo-backend-p2-093; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-084; c-198)

In the high-risk plants frontend, Amend on a submitted plants notification's card (and on its view page) opens the same amend confirmation page with the same title, heading, question, 'Yes, continue' and 'No, go back'; 'Yes, continue' lands on plants' review page for that notification, and a refused amend returns to plants' own notification list with no message (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-043; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-115, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-134; c-310)

On the workspace stack, the k6 performance suite's amendment journey passes with Amend landing on the amend review: its 'amendment started' check expects the review page, it still edits the origin page, and both its endings still pass, cancelling at cancel-amend to land on the view page with ?cancelled=1, or resubmitting through the review and the declaration (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-071, repo-perftests-p1-072, repo-perftests-p1-074; c-225)

With the service in Welsh, the amend confirmation page's title, heading, question and controls show Welsh text, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-089; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-114)
rows.gate: Look at the amend confirmation page in animals and plants, and the card's Amend now a link to it: the cancel-amendment page and the germinal set's copy follow the same page pattern.
rows.notes: Unchanged in substance by this re-distil. Pass 2 combines the confirmation page (req-1391, req-1392), the landing (req-1394), the guard (req-1487) and the k6 check (req-1877): one route, one page, one review and ladder. The dialog half of req-1391/req-1392 is req-1393's, in the blocked waiting-on-design row. The card's Amend action today lives in each frontend's dashboard feature (a POST from the list; plants' amend is handled in its dashboard feature); it becomes a link to this page, which the animals-dashboard theme's list rows must keep. The view page's 'Amend this notification' comes from inc-112 (plants too), which this row needs landed. Welsh strings here are part of req-1480, carried by the delete page row. Keep its manage-notifications theme.

rows.title: The cancel-amendment page takes Design Release 2.1's wording and returns to the submitted view with no banner, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 confirms cancelling an amendment with a shorter heading, no explanatory paragraph and a link-styled 'Go back', and then shows the restored submitted notification without a success banner. Today the cancel-amend page reads 'Cancel this amendment?', explains that changes will be discarded, offers a secondary 'No, return to notification' button, carries the journey strip and a Back link, and the restored view shows a Success banner. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps the confirmation a separate page at today's route with the pop-up's wording as its content (c-190). After this change the page carries only the heading and its two controls, the restored view shows no banner while its address keeps ?cancelled=1 (c-268), and opening or posting it for a notification that is not being amended returns the trader to the set's own notification list (c-198). Plants' cancel-amend page changes the same way in the same increment.
acceptanceCriteria: The cancel-amendment confirmation page's title and level-1 heading are 'Are you sure you want to cancel this amendment?', with no caption (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-052; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-085; c-195)

The page shows no paragraph saying the changes will be discarded and the submitted version restored (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-085; c-195)

The page's way back is a link-styled 'Go back' that returns to the amend review with the amendment still in progress and its changed answers kept; no 'No, return to notification' button appears (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-084; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-085; c-195)

'Cancel amend' beside Continue on the amend review and the card's 'Cancel amendment' both reach this page at /notifications/{id}/cancel-amend, which shows only the heading, 'Yes, cancel amendment' and 'Go back': no journey strip and no Back link (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-086; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-078, repo-frontend-p3-138; c-190)

After 'Yes, cancel amendment' the trader lands on the notification's view page, read only and showing Submitted, with no success banner; the page's address still carries ?cancelled=1 (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-088; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; c-268)

Opening the cancel-amendment page by its address, or posting it, for a notification that is not being amended (such as a Submitted one) changes nothing and returns the trader, with no message, to the set's own notification list (the live-animals set root) (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-128; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-084; c-198)

In the high-risk plants frontend, the cancel-amendment page has the same title and heading, no explanatory paragraph, no Back link and a link-styled 'Go back' to plants' check answers view; after 'Yes, cancel amendment' plants' view shows no success banner and its address keeps ?cancelled=1; and opening or posting it for a plants notification not being amended returns to plants' own notification list with no message (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-044; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-100, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-101, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-104, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-105, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-109, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-110)

With the service in Welsh, the cancel-amendment page's heading and 'Go back' show Welsh text, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-089; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-114)

rows.title: An amendment shows an 'Amend' status bar with Cancel amend on the review and every question page, in every set that amends
rows.detail: While a notification is amended, Design Release 2.1 shows an 'Amend' status bar with the reference and a 'Cancel amend' control above the caption and heading of the review and every question page. Today the tag reads 'Amending' and only the review page offers a 'Cancel amendment' link, under its heading. The 9 October afternoon ruling makes this the one change to the shared status strip itself: it adds Cancel amend for status AMEND and changes 'Amending' to 'Amend' in every set at once, live animals, germinal products and plants. The bar's Cancel amend goes to the cancel-amendment confirmation page, a page and never a pop-up.
acceptanceCriteria: While a notification is being amended, its status tag on the amend review and on its question pages reads 'Amend', not 'Amending' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-063; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-111)

During an amendment the review page and every question page show, above the caption and heading, a status bar with the 'Amend' tag, the notification's reference and a link-styled 'Cancel amend' control (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-063, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-070; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-112; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-066, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067)

'Cancel amend' in a question page's status bar goes to the cancel-amendment confirmation page; its way back leaves the amendment in progress, and 'Yes, cancel amendment' restores the submitted answers and lands on the read-only Submitted view (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-086, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-088; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-086)
A draft notification's pages show the 'Draft' tag and reference in the strip with no 'Cancel amend' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-094-m1)
The status bar's 'Cancel amend' works with JavaScript turned off (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-086; c-190)

In the high-risk plants frontend, a plants notification being amended shows the same 'Amend' tag, reference and 'Cancel amend' control above the caption and heading of its review and question pages, going to plants' cancel-amendment page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-066, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-045)
With the service in Welsh, the 'Amend' tag and 'Cancel amend' show Welsh text, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-089; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-114)

In the germinal products set too, an amended notification's strip tag reads 'Amend', changed once in the shared strip, and the end-to-end checks that read 'Amending' read 'Amend' (repo:tests repo-tests-p6-116; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-066, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-068; c-311)

Plants keeps its own copy of the shared layout and kit, so the same strip change is made there in this increment. rows.title: Copy as new carries over exactly Design Release 2.1's list, from the submitted version
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 says what a copy keeps (origin, internal reference, what is imported with its species, the reasons and their follow-ups, the additional animal details, the parties and CPH) and what it leaves for the trader to fill in again (numbers of animals and packages, identifiers, arrival, transit, transporter, documents and contact address). Today the backend copy mapper and the pages disagree: the record clears the internal reference, the species, the unweaned answer and the exit date, yet the copy's overview shows counts, identification, arrival, transit, transport and contact address as Complete because the whole answer payload is copied. c-196 settles that a copy carries exactly Design Release 2.1's list, in the record and on the pages alike, and c-197 that copying an amendment in progress copies its submitted version. After this change a copy keeps and clears what Design Release 2.1 says, and a certified-for value no longer offered is mapped to a current one. Plants does not offer Copy as new, so plants is not changed.
acceptanceCriteria: A copy's origin of the import comes back with the source's internal reference number, and the copy's review shows it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-063; c-196)

A copy's commodity pages come back with the source's commodity, its commodity selections and the selected species, and the copy has the source's notification type (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-064, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-071; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101; c-196)

A copy's import reason pages come back with the main reason for import and its follow-ups: internal market purpose, transhipment destination country, transit exit border control post, transit destination country, and the temporary admission exit date and port of exit (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-065; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101; c-196)

A copy's additional details come back with what the animals are certified for, whether unweaned animals are included and the storage temperature (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-066; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101; c-196)

On the workspace stack, copying a live-animals notification stored through the backend API with certified-for 'Breeding' or 'Breeding and/or production' gives a copy certified for 'Further keeping', 'Slaughter' stays 'Slaughter', and any other value not offered gives 'Further keeping' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-070)

A copy's overview shows Commodity details as To do, its Animals total reads 0 and its Packages/boxes total shows no figure (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-102; c-196)

A copy's overview shows Identification details, Arrival details, Transport details and Contact address as To do (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101; c-196)
A copy's transit countries page comes back with none of the source's transit countries (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; c-196)

Copying a notification that is being amended copies its submitted version: an answer changed during the amendment and not yet resubmitted does not appear on the copy, and the submitted answer does (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-059; c-197)
rows.notes: Unchanged in substance by this re-distil: Copy as new goes ahead unchanged (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-087) and plants does not offer it (req-2003, req-2055 out of scope), so no plants half. Pass 1 had two slices, what a copy keeps (req-1424, req-1425, req-1428, req-1429, req-1430) and what it clears (req-1426, req-1427, req-1432 to req-1435); pass 2 merges them with copying the submitted version of an amendment (req-1437) because each changes the same backend copy mapping and the frontend's stub persistence copy, proven by copying one full notification and reading the copy. What a copy already keeps or clears correctly (req-1423, req-1431, req-1436) stays. The copy must clear the cleared answers from the copied answer payload as well as the record, so the overview's task statuses follow. The certified-for mapping criterion is written for the workspace stack only, where a notification with a retired value can be stored through the backend API. The germinal halves (req-1879, req-1880) are the germinal row's. Keep its manage-notifications theme.

rows.title: A stale Copy as new from the view page returns to the view page with the updated banner
rows.detail: Copy as new is checked against the version of the notification the trader was looking at, so a copy of something that has changed since is refused with 'The notification has been updated'. Started from the notification list this works today, but started from the view page it redirects to a check-answers address no route serves. After this change a stale copy returns the trader to where they started, the list or the notification's view page, with the banner, and copies nothing.
acceptanceCriteria: When the notification changed after the trader opened its view page (for example amended from another tab), Copy as new on that view page copies nothing and returns the trader to the notification's view page showing 'The notification has been updated' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-074, repo-frontend-p3-075-m1; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-040)

When the notification changed after the trader opened the notification list, Copy as new on its card copies nothing and returns the trader to the notification list showing 'The notification has been updated' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-074; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-035, repo-backend-p2-040)
After a refused stale copy, no new draft appears in the notification list (repo:backend repo-backend-p2-040; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-106)
rows.notes: Unchanged by this re-distil. Kept apart from the copy carry-over row: a frontend redirect fix with its own set-up (two tabs and a stale version). Plants does not offer Copy as new, so no plants half. The view page's Copy as new button comes from inc-112, which this row needs landed. Keep its manage-notifications theme.

rows.title: The delete confirmation page identifies the notification in a summary and takes Design Release 2.1's wording and buttons, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 shows which notification is about to be deleted, in a summary of its reference, commodity, number and origin, and words the page and its buttons more briefly, with a plain 'No, cancel' link back to the notification. Today the page has only a heading, one sentence and two buttons, shows the journey strip, and its way back goes to the list. c-195 adopts Design Release 2.1's copy. After this change the page shows the summary list, the new wording and buttons, and Back and 'No, cancel' return to the notification's view page. The 9 October afternoon ruling makes the same change to plants' delete page in the same increment, filled with plants' own commodity, origin and quantity, and plants' own checks move with it. In the live-animals set the Number row is the total number of animals; the germinal packages case is the germinal set's.
acceptanceCriteria: The delete confirmation page shows a GOV.UK summary list with the rows 'Reference number', 'Commodity', 'Number' and 'Origin', the Origin row showing the country of origin (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-173, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-176; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-107, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-111; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-138; c-195)

The Commodity row lists each commodity's common name with its species' Latin names in brackets, comma-separated, such as 'Sheep (Ovis Aries), Goat (Capra Hircus)'; for other live mammals it uses each species' common name (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-174; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-107; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-139)

For a live-animals notification the Number row shows the notification's total number of animals (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-175; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

A summary row the notification has no value for shows what the set's notification list shows for that notification, and 'Not applicable' when that is empty too (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-177)

Below the summary the page says 'Confirm that you want to delete this notification.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-178; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-108; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-140; c-195)

The page warns 'This action cannot be undone.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-178; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-108; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-141; c-195)
The red warning button reads 'Yes, delete' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-179; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-109; c-195)

rows.title: The deletion message reads 'Notification has been deleted' on each set's own list, and deleting an amending notification is proven
rows.detail: After a delete the trader already lands on the set's own notification list with ?deleted=1, which shows the deletion message straight away (req-1454, req-1881, already met). Design Release 2.1 words the message 'Notification has been deleted', its wording for a page that does not know the deleted reference; today it reads 'The notification has been deleted.'. Deleting a notification being amended already works, but nothing proves it and the backend's API description still says only drafts and submitted notifications can be deleted. After this change both the animals list and plants' own list say 'Notification has been deleted', the API description lists AMEND, and the end-to-end suite proves deleting an amending notification and the guard redirects of amend, cancel amendment, copy and delete, still asserting ?cancelled=1 and ?deleted=1 and keeping its smoke-tagged cancel and delete cases.
acceptanceCriteria: After 'Yes, delete' the live-animals notification list, opened at ?deleted=1, shows the success message 'Notification has been deleted' in place of 'The notification has been deleted.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-183; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-145; c-269)

In the high-risk plants frontend, plants' own notification list opened at ?deleted=1 after a delete shows the success message 'Notification has been deleted' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-053; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-094)

A notification being amended can be deleted from the amend review's Delete button: after 'Yes, delete' it no longer appears in the notification list, in animals and in plants (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-118; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-091; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-085)

On the workspace stack, the backend's published API description for deleting a notification says DRAFT, SUBMITTED and AMEND notifications can be deleted (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034, repo-backend-p3-035)

The end-to-end suite on the workspace stack proves that an amending notification can be deleted, and that amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete for a notification that cannot take that action return to the set's own notification list with no message; it still asserts ?cancelled=1 on the cancel-amendment redirect and ?deleted=1 on the delete redirect, and its smoke-tagged cancel-amendment and delete cases still run in the smoke suite and assert the Design Release 2.1 copy and landings (repo:tests repo-tests-p3-094 to repo-tests-p3-096, repo-tests-p3-099, repo-tests-p3-209, repo-tests-p3-209-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-135-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; c-198)

rows.title: Amend, cancel amend, copy as new and delete for germinal products notifications
rows.detail: A submitted germinal products notification is managed on the germinal set's own copies of the amend, cancel amend, notification actions and delete pages, taken from the live-animals ones once this programme has changed them. The delete page counts packages where live animals count animals, and a copy stays a germinal products notification with its certified-for answer.

rows.title: Waiting on design: the amend and cancel-amendment pop-ups
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 opens the amend and cancel-amendment confirmations as modal dialogs over the current page. GOV.UK Frontend has no modal, the Ministry of Justice's Modal dialog is not accepted (Experimental, no documented fallback without JavaScript), and no increment writes custom JavaScript to copy the prototype. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the confirmations now as pages carrying the pop-ups' wording, and holds the pop-ups themselves as one waiting-on-design increment for both animals sets and plants, blocked on design question 9. The expected answer is that they are not built, and the increment is then dropped; it is built only if design makes a strong case, as design then says.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, 'Amend this notification' and 'Cancel amend' open their confirmations as modal dialogs over the current page instead of going to the confirmation pages, each hidden until opened, announced as a modal dialog named by its heading (the amend dialog also described by its question), with a Close (X) button announced as 'Close' and an overlay (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-029, prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-030, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-183, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-060, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-061)

Close, the overlay and the dialog's 'No, go back' or 'Go back' dismiss it without acting and leave the trader where they were (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-084)
With JavaScript turned off, the same controls still reach the amend and cancel-amendment confirmation pages and work as before (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-088)
The same dialogs and fallbacks apply in the high-risk plants frontend (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-088)
openQuestions: Design question 9 (design must answer): are the amend and cancel-amendment pop-ups built at all, and if so with which tested component? Expected answer: not built, and this increment is dropped. Built only if design makes a strong case; MoJ's Modal dialog is not accepted (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 7 and 19).
